reels.title: M25 BIR DAKIKA
reels.caption:
He couldn't run for one minute. So he ran for one. 🏃

Day 30, rain, he falls. Day 95, snow, 5 kilometers. Day 200, nobody's clapping. One year later: half marathon.

It started with one minute.

Send this to someone who says they can't.

#running #discipline #selfimprovement #motivation #habits

reels.title: M20 DIVAR (IG tekrar)
reels.caption:
You don't have no time. You have 4 hours a night on your phone. 🧱

Day 1, same evening. One lays a brick. One opens his phone. Day 30, the wall falls. He starts again. A year later, one built something. The other scrolled 1,460 hours.

Same evenings. Different year.

Send this to someone who says they have no time.

#discipline #screentime #selfimprovement #motivation #habits

reels.title: M24 STANQ
reels.caption:
Monday never comes. Today does. 🏋️

Day 1, same goal. One lifts the smallest weight. One waits for Monday. Day 30, the weight wins. He lifts again. Heavier. A year later: 120 kg. The other missed 52 Mondays.

Send this to someone starting on Monday.

#gym #discipline #fitness #motivation #selfimprovement
